50 Years Later
April 2003, Conference announcing the completion of the Human Genome ProjectBethesda, MD, National Institute of Health (NIH)
explanation: This slide notes the 50-year anniversary of the Watson and Crick double helix publication (1953 to 2003). In April 2003, a major conference held at the National Institutes of Health (NIH) in Bethesda, Maryland, announced the completion of the Human Genome Project, marking a monumental milestone in molecular genetics.

questions.q: What milestone in genetics was announced 50 years after the discovery of the DNA double helix?
opts: The completion of the Human Genome Project
questions.exp: Option B is correct because the slide states that in April 2003 (50 years after the 1953 model), a conference announced the completion of the Human Genome Project. Options A, C, and D are incorrect.
